block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Dynamic visual glow gradients and aura hues for the Twin Relics and Moral Sway.
what_it_enables: Dynamic aura resonance gradients for the Shield of Lux (Radiant Solar Gold) and Sword of Tenebris (Twilight Amethyst)
Continuous moral sway continuum color interpolation across [-100, +100] centered on vibrant equilibrium
Enduring hope visualization: radiant dawn amber bursts and triumphant celestial overloads
Tactile weight: grounded quiescent metallic bases rising to brilliant luminous clarity
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in aura gradient interpolation (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
The game is grounded and real to the touch, dark in places, but fundamentally illuminated by hope
Moral sway spectrum values strictly bounded between -100 and +100
Aura pulse frequencies must be strictly positive

shield_of_lux.description: The Aegis of Radiance: enduring protective hope shining with the warmth of the rising sun.

sword_of_tenebris.description: The Edge of Severance: solemn twilight gravity cutting away despair to restore balanced harmony.

tripwires.action: Clamp moral sway input before color lookup
Clamp aura pulse frequency to minimum 0.1 Hz
